evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/gui/b/g owns a static ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, rs.gui.x> keyed by item id, a five-thread ExecutorService, five loader instances, a round-robin loader index, one cached image field and one LoadoutItemEntry.

Its image lookup first checks the shared item-id cache; on a miss it dispatches the LoadoutItemEntry item id to one of the five loaders and returns null, while on a hit it memoizes and returns the cached rs.gui.x image.
The class is constructed from LoadoutItemEntry/item id and is consumed by the reviewed Loadout preview path; no unrelated exact-v308 subsystem owns this cache.

proposals.note: LoadoutItemImageCache is fixed by the shared item-id image cache plus bounded loadout-item lookup/dispatch role. Confidence 0.999.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/gui/b/b/b schedules item-id image work through the surviving task key literal pattern LoadoutIco_<itemId>.

Its loader callback resolves the item sprite at quantity 1 and size 32, converts it to an Image, removes black background pixels, wraps the result in rs.gui.x and stores it into rs/gui/b/g's shared item-id cache.
After caching an image it asks the live Launcher to refresh the relevant UI path; the class has no unrelated exact-v308 consumer outside the loadout item-image cache family.

proposals.note: LoadoutItemImageLoader is a descriptive exact-behavior name for the async item-image loader used by LoadoutItemImageCache; it does not claim an original developer identifier.
